_doc: DATE-PHRASING R1 (docs/DATE-PHRASING-PLAN.md §4): parameters only — Resolve Date (calendar dates, the A1 horizon, D-5, the D-4 strike), Slot Gate (the re-ask by reason) Reschedule Lookup (carries D-4's marker; ruling 2026-11-01, Codex R2 MEDIUM-6), Compute Availability and Compute Reschedule Availability (R2d, ruling 2026-11-02: the year in both confirm asks); Load Config gains exactly the plan's two config keys (business.dateOrder and bot.bookingHorizonDays, inline in their one-line objects) and six templates (gate_edits, checked key-exact).

Load Config.messageTemplates.askDateTimeHint: Which day and time? You can write e.g. "Wednesday at 11:00", "tomorrow at 15:00" or "4 November at 11:00".
Load Config.messageTemplates.dateWeekdayMismatch: {date} is a {actual} — did you mean {actual} {date}, or a {said}?
Load Config.messageTemplates.datePast: That date has passed — which date did you mean?
Load Config.messageTemplates.dateInvalid: That date is not on the calendar — which date did you mean?
Load Config.messageTemplates.dateTooFar: We take bookings up to {days} days ahead — which date did you mean?
